_doc: Fixed piece layout. Never edit a published layout: a geometry change makes a new version. Cells are [X, Y, W, H, rotated] in mm, Studio frame (landscape Letter, origin top-left, y down). 'pieces' lists the pieces in printed order (top, middle, bottom: printed top = Studio right, highest X). Every piece holds the same arrangement: a middle piece is the top piece translated by whole piece widths, the bottom piece is the top piece mirrored about the page centre (pieces[-1][i] mirrors pieces[0][i]).
